title: Department of Pharmaceuticals OM dated 18.02.2022 for List of Manufacturers for 340 medical devices to the procuring Agencies

info.Title: Department of Pharmaceuticals OM dated 18.02.2022 for List of Manufacturers for 340 medical devices to the procuring Agencies

text: No. 31026/176/2021-MD Government of India Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers Department of Phannaceuticals **** Janpath Bhawan, New Delhi Dated 18th February, 2022 OFFICE MEMORANDUM Subject: List oflocal manufacturers for 340 medical devices to the Procuring Agencies - request to share with the Central procuring agencies - reg. The undersigned is directed to refer to this Department Public Notice dated 18.12.2021 vide which medical devices in two lists (493 Medical Devices viz, 128 in List-I and 365 in List-2 ofAnnexure-1 of the Public Notice) were published to seek the details of local manufacturers for the purpose of procurement under Public Procureme nt (Preference to Make in India) Order, 2017. This exercise was taken up in concurrence of DPIIT, pursuant to the representations received from procuring agencies under GoI such as CMSS, ESIC, AIIMS, Railway Board, DGAFMS, HITES, etc with regard to non-availability of Class-I or Class- II suppliers for identified Medical Devices/Equipment. Subsequently, Public Notice dated 01.02.2022 was published seeking further inputs from the industry/medical device associations. 02. In this regard, based on the inputs received from the Local Manufacturers and Associations, a consolidated list of 340 (105+235) M edical Devices/Equipment has been arrived at, where the local manufacturers are available, pursuant to the Public Notices of DoP. The list of these medical devices/equipment is placed at Annexure-1. It is requested to circulate the above list of 340 Medical Devices with particulars of Local Manufacturers, to all the procuring entities under the Department so as to help them in procurement of the said medical devices/equipment. 03. It is also to inform that DoP has already published the list of 19 Medical Devices with Local Manufacturers on DoP's portal*. Further, the details of 69 Medical Devices with Local Manufacturers, as shared with the States/UTs, are also attached at Annexure-2. -- 1 of 414 -- 04. Hence, the above said li sts of manufacturers may kindly be shared with all the Procuring Agencies, to help them in procurement of the said medical devices/equipment. 05. This issues with the approval of Secretary, DoP. ~)MW (Arvind Kumar) Under Secretary to the Govt. of India Email: arvind.76 @gov.in Tele: 011-23352298 To 1.
